verdict.rationale: Claude Design can import your real components from GitHub or a local codebase and sync design systems via /design-sync. Its designs are HTML/CSS/JS, exportable as HTML. A handoff bundle passes them to Claude Code for implementation, and users report shippable landing pages and a solid design-to-Claude-Code flow. However, one hands-on user calls the generated code unmaintainable and disposable, and the production path relies on a separate tool (Claude Code). Missing for 10: documented component-to-code mapping detail, evidence that the direct output is maintainable production code without a Claude Code rewrite, and in-depth first-party handoff docs.
